dog.description_text:
With big ears and eyes full of love, Gwen is ready to find her forever home! She came to ARF all the way from California, where she was found by local Animal Control.
Gwen is looking for a best friend to play with and a special person to snuggle up with. Like any young pup, she’ll need to learn the puppy basics, including housebreaking and basic obedience. With patience, guidance, and plenty of love, Gwen is sure to grow into the very best girl!
